notes: Eclipse Loop 1.5.7 Mixer / Arranger - Mute and Solo on the arranger mixer are now realtime — toggling M/S during playback takes effect instantly instead of only after stop/play. - Floating Mixer and Arranger windows now have a DOCK button, so you can dock them to the bottom without closing and re-opening. (The dock's FLOAT button still pops them back out.) Stability - Fixed static when loading an effect with a sidechain or aux input (e.g. a compressor) onto an arranger track — those plugins were being fed a too-small buffer and reading past the end. Insert buffers are now sized safely.
